name: Muha Meds Disposable (3rd Gen) | Sweet Dreams OG
description: Sweet Dreams OG is that classic heavy hitter: earthy with a citrus twist, grounding yet hazy. It’s the kind of indica that clears your schedule for the night, wrapping you in a slow fade to chill mode. Bold flavor, bold high, pure knockout vibes.
